caption: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth, topped with tender chashu, crisp menma, and shredded cabbage. Served in a white bowl with red trim, it rests on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain pattern, and subtle light reflections.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with visible fat marbling and slightly glistening surface.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy yellow, with visible noodles, green onions, and a pink swirl of sauce floating on its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale yellow, slightly translucent, elongated strips with a glossy surface and faint fibrous texture.
White ceramic ramen bowl with red checkered pattern and black "ARASAKI" logo on its rim.
A metallic spoon with a reflective surface, curved bowl, and slightly worn handle edge.
